notes:
Summary: LucidLane builds an outbound sales automation/chat product used by SDR teams at mid-market SaaS customers. Primary need: low-latency streaming chat UI + reliable tool-calling (Salesforce reads/writes, Gmail drafts, calendar invites). They want to evaluate Hosted API first; if latency and cost predictability are acceptable, they will move to Dedicated (VPC) for isolation and predictable throughput.

Key requirements/asks: 
- Streaming SLO: p95 token/packet latency target <= 200ms end-to-end for UI feel; tail behavior (p99) needs explanation.
- Tool calling: secure function/tool invocations for CRM/email/calendar with auditing; need examples for OAuth delegation patterns and KMS-backed signing.
- Throughput: POC expects 10 concurrent agent sessions during peak campaign tests (~200 reqs/min), eventual scale to 150-200 concurrent.
- Cost sensitivity: target conversation cost <$0.05 average, planning ARR band 50k-200k, wants clear unit economics to justify Dedicated.
- Security: SOC2 required, SSO/SAML, audit logs retention 1 year, EU data residency for a subset of customers.

Notes from calls: 
- "We need the streaming feel to match our native app — even small token delays break agent speed." — Head of Product.
- SE: Jordan demoed function-calls writing a Salesforce note and creating a calendar invite; LucidLane liked the end-to-end flow but wants guaranteed latency for tool-call round-trips.

POC plan: 
- 2-week Hosted API POC: measure p95/p99 for initial token and for full response, validate tool-calling latency for Salesforce/Gmail flows, run a simulated campaign of 2k conversations, collect cost report.
- If meets SLO & cost targets -> provide Dedicated capacity quote (monthly commit), propose canary migration for top 50 accounts.

Risks/concerns: 
- If Hosted tail latency too high, UX breaks and Dedicated may still be required but with higher committed cost.
- Need security answers before procurement (SOC2 evidence + KMS integration docs).

Action items: 
- AE (Maya): send Hosted POC contract + usage baseline template by 2026-03-07.
- SE (Jordan): supply sample streaming benchmarks at similar concurrency and a tech note on function-call latency mitigation.
- Security: share SOC2/ISO docs + architecture note for VPC/private control plane.
